Using \(F_D = kv^2\), terminal velocity satisfies  
\[
mg = k v_t^2 \quad\Rightarrow\quad v_t=\sqrt{\frac{mg}{k}}.
\]
The equation of motion is  
\[
m v\frac{dv}{dh}=mg-kv^2.
\]
Integrating from \(v=0\) to \(v=0.95v_t\):
\[
h=\frac{m}{2k}\ln\left(\frac{1}{1-0.95^2}\right)
=\frac{80}{2(0.27)}\ln\left(\frac{1}{0.0975}\right)
\approx 344.8745.
\]
